title: Paranormal Pub Crawl in Austin
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Austin after dark with a local storyteller — haunted bars, hidden history, rooftop views, and the city’s most infamous ghost stories.

This isn’t a scripted history lecture or a crowded tourist trap. Part ghost tour, part nightlife experience, the night is built around immersive storytelling, eerie legends, and the darker side of downtown Austin after midnight.

From the Driskill Hotel to hidden alleyways and historic pubs, you’ll hear the stories that still linger through downtown after dark.

-Two hours of vivid storytelling, history, and hauntings

-Explore historic bars and landmarks with a local storyteller

-Drinks available for purchase at each stop

-Built for a social, interactive, and more personal group experience
